## Summary

Brief description of the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor

## Changes

- List the main files/modules changed.
- Highlight any new dependencies or removed code.

## Testing

- [ ] `cd agent && npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `cd agent && npm run test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (for web app changes)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Simulator or live run verified

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, keys, or `.env` values committed
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] PR is focused on a single concern
